objectives.q: Which Article of the Indian Constitution empowers the President of India to issue Ordinances during recess of Parliament?
objectives.exp:
💡 सही उत्तर: A) Article 123।
विस्तृत व्याख्या: Under Article 123, if both houses of Parliament are not in session and the President is satisfied that circumstances exist which render it necessary, he may promulgate an Ordinance.

objectives.q: Who was the permanent President of the Constituent Assembly of India elected on December 11, 1946?
options: B) Dr. Sachchidananda Sinha (Interim Chairman - Dec 9, 1946)
objectives.exp:
💡 सही उत्तर: A) Dr. Rajendra Prasad।
विस्तृत व्याख्या: Dr. Rajendra Prasad was elected permanent President of the Constituent Assembly on December 11, 1946. H.C. Mukherjee was elected Vice-President and B.N. Rau was the Constitutional Advisor.

objectives.q: Fundamental Duties were incorporated into the Indian Constitution by which Constitutional Amendment on the recommendation of the Swaran Singh Committee?
objectives.exp:
💡 सही उत्तर: A) 42nd Amendment Act 1976 (Article 51A)।
विस्तृत व्याख्या: The 42nd Amendment (1976) added Part IV-A and Article 51A containing 10 Fundamental Duties borrowed from the USSR. The 11th duty was added by the 86th Amendment in 2002.

objectives.q: Which Constitutional Amendment made Elementary Education a Fundamental Right under Article 21A for children aged 6 to 14 years?
objectives.exp:
💡 सही उत्तर: A) 86th Constitutional Amendment Act 2002।
विस्तृत व्याख्या: The 86th Amendment Act 2002 inserted Article 21A making free and compulsory elementary education a fundamental right for children between 6 and 14 years.

objectives.q: Under which Article of the Indian Constitution is the Comptroller and Auditor General (CAG) of India appointed?
objectives.exp:
💡 सही उत्तर: A) Article 148।
विस्तृत व्याख्या: Article 148 provides that there shall be a Comptroller and Auditor General of India who shall be appointed by the President by warrant under his hand and seal.

objectives.q: Who acts as the ex-officio Chairman of the Rajya Sabha (Council of States)?
objectives.exp:
💡 सही उत्तर: A) Vice-President of India (Article 64)।
विस्तृत व्याख्या: Under Article 64 and Article 89(1), the Vice-President of India is the ex-officio Chairman of the Rajya Sabha.

objectives.q: Panchayati Raj was first introduced in India on October 2, 1959 in which district?
objectives.exp:
💡 सही उत्तर: A) Nagaur (Rajasthan)।
विस्तृत व्याख्या: Prime Minister Jawaharlal Nehru inaugurated India's first 3-tier Panchayati Raj system at Nagaur, Rajasthan on October 2, 1959 based on the Balwant Rai Mehta Committee recommendations.

objectives.q: The concept of 'Single Citizenship' in the Indian Constitution was adopted from which country?
objectives.exp:
💡 सही उत्तर: A) Britain (United Kingdom)।
विस्तृत व्याख्या: India adopted single citizenship for the entire nation from the British constitutional system, unlike the United States which has dual citizenship (federal and state).

objectives.q: At which Indus Valley site was the bronze statue of a 'Dancing Girl' discovered?
objectives.exp:
💡 सही उत्तर: A) Mohenjo-daro।
विस्तृत व्याख्या: The famous lost-wax bronze figurine of the Dancing Girl (circa 2500 BCE) was discovered by Ernest Mackay at Mohenjo-daro in 1926.

objectives.q: Lothal, the prominent dockyard and port city of the Harappan civilization, was situated along which river in Gujarat?
objectives.exp:
💡 सही उत्तर: A) Bhogava River (Gulf of Khambhat)।
विस्तृत व्याख्या: Lothal was excavated by S.R. Rao in 1957. It is located on the Bhogava River in the Bhal region of Gujarat and possessed the world's earliest known tidal dockyard.

objectives.q: Kalibangan, famous for ploughed agricultural fields and fire altars, is situated in which Indian state?
objectives.exp:
💡 सही उत्तर: A) Rajasthan (Hanumangarh district, Ghaggar river)।
विस्तृत व्याख्या: Kalibangan (meaning Black Bangles) is located on the banks of the Ghaggar river in Rajasthan. Excavations revealed the earliest ploughed agricultural field in the world.

objectives.q: The rock-cut temples of Ellora (including the magnificent Kailash Temple) were constructed under the patronage of which dynasty?
objectives.exp:
💡 सही उत्तर: A) Rashtrakuta Dynasty (King Krishna I)।
विस्तृत व्याख्या: The monolithic Kailash Temple (Cave 16) at Ellora (Maharashtra) was carved top-down from a single basalt cliff under the Rashtrakuta king Krishna I in the 8th century.

objectives.q: Who was the author of the famous book 'Kitab-ul-Hind' (Tahqiq-i-Hind)?
objectives.exp:
💡 सही उत्तर: A) Al-Biruni (Abu Rayhan al-Biruni)।
विस्तृत व्याख्या: Al-Biruni accompanied Sultan Mahmud of Ghazni to India in the 11th century and wrote the encyclopedia 'Kitab-ul-Hind', describing Indian culture, religion, mathematics and astronomy.

objectives.q: Ibn Battuta, the Moroccan traveler who visited India during the reign of Muhammad bin Tughlaq, wrote which famous travelogue?
objectives.exp:
💡 सही उत्तर: A) Rihla (The Journey)।
विस्तृत व्याख्या: Ibn Battuta arrived in India in 1334 from Tangier, Morocco. Muhammad bin Tughlaq appointed him as the Qazi (Judge) of Delhi. He recorded his journeys in 'Rihla'.

objectives.q: Who introduced the market control and price regulation system (Shahna-i-Mandi) in Delhi Sultanate?
objectives.exp:
💡 सही उत्तर: A) Alauddin Khilji।
विस्तृत व्याख्या: Alauddin Khilji introduced strict price control for all commodities (food grains, cloth, horses, slaves) and appointed an intelligence officer (Munhiyans) and market controller (Shahna-i-Mandi).

objectives.q: In which year did the Battle of Buxar take place, establishing British East India Company's administrative and revenue supremacy in Bengal, Bihar and Orissa?
objectives.exp:
💡 सही उत्तर: A) 22 October 1764।
विस्तृत व्याख्या: At the Battle of Buxar (1764), British forces led by Major Hector Munro defeated the combined forces of Mir Qasim (Bengal), Shuja-ud-Daula (Awadh) and Mughal Emperor Shah Alam II.

objectives.q: Who introduced the 'Permanent Settlement' (इस्तमरारी / जमींदारी बंदोबस्त) of land revenue in Bengal and Bihar in 1793?
options: A) Lord Cornwallis (with Sir John Shore)
objectives.ans: A) Lord Cornwallis (with Sir John Shore)
objectives.exp:
💡 सही उत्तर: A) Lord Cornwallis (with Sir John Shore)।
विस्तृत व्याख्या: Lord Cornwallis introduced the Permanent Settlement in 1793, where zamindars were recognized as landowners and paid a fixed 10/11th share of collected revenue to the Company.

objectives.q: The 'Doctrine of Lapse' (व्यपगत का सिद्धांत) was vigorously applied by which Governor-General to annex Indian princely states like Satara, Sambalpur, Jhansi and Nagpur?
objectives.exp:
💡 सही उत्तर: A) Lord Dalhousie (1848-1856)।
विस्तृत व्याख्या: Lord Dalhousie annexed states without a natural male heir: Satara (1848), Jaitpur & Sambalpur (1849), Baghat (1850), Udaipur (1852), Jhansi (1853) and Nagpur (1854). Awadh was annexed on grounds of misgovernance (1856).

objectives.q: Who founded the 'Brahmo Samaj' in Calcutta in 1828 to reform Hindu society and eradicate Sati practice?
options: A) Raja Rammohan Roy (Father of Indian Renaissance)
objectives.ans: A) Raja Rammohan Roy (Father of Indian Renaissance)
objectives.exp:
💡 सही उत्तर: A) Raja Rammohan Roy (Father of Indian Renaissance)।
विस्तृत व्याख्या: Raja Rammohan Roy founded the Atmiya Sabha (1815) and Brahmo Samaj (1828). With his persistent efforts, Lord William Bentinck banned Sati in 1829 under Regulation XVII.

objectives.q: Who presided over the historic 1929 Lahore Session of the Indian National Congress where the 'Purna Swaraj' (Complete Independence) resolution was passed?
objectives.exp:
💡 सही उत्तर: A) Jawaharlal Nehru।
विस्तृत व्याख्या: In December 1929 at Lahore on the banks of River Ravi, Jawaharlal Nehru presided over the INC session where Purna Swaraj was declared the sole goal, and 26 January 1930 was celebrated as Independence Day.

objectives.q: Which Indian state has the longest coastline (तटरेखा)?
objectives.exp:
💡 सही उत्तर: A) Gujarat (approx. 1,600 km)।
विस्तृत व्याख्या: Gujarat has the longest mainland coastline in India (1,600 km) followed by Andhra Pradesh (974 km) and Tamil Nadu (906 km). Total coastline of India is 7,516.6 km.

objectives.q: Majuli, the world's largest inhabited river island, is located in which river and state?
options: B) Ganga River in West Bengal
C) Godavari River in Andhra Pradesh
objectives.exp:
💡 सही उत्तर: A) Brahmaputra River in Assam।
विस्तृत व्याख्या: Majuli is formed by the Brahmaputra River and its tributaries Kherkutia Xuti and Subansiri in Assam. It was declared the first river island district of India in 2016.

objectives.q: Through how many Indian states does the Tropic of Cancer (23°30' N) pass?
options: A) 8 states (Gujarat, Rajasthan, MP, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, West Bengal, Tripura, Mizoram)
objectives.ans: A) 8 states (Gujarat, Rajasthan, MP, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, West Bengal, Tripura, Mizoram)
objectives.exp:
💡 सही उत्तर: A) 8 states (Gujarat, Rajasthan, MP, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, West Bengal, Tripura, Mizoram)।
विस्तृत व्याख्या: The Tropic of Cancer passes through 8 states from west to east: Gujarat, Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, West Bengal, Tripura and Mizoram.

objectives.q: The 'Ten Degree Channel' (10° Channel) separates which two island groups in the Bay of Bengal?
options: A) Andaman Islands and Nicobar Islands (Little Andaman & Car Nicobar)
B) North Andaman and Middle Andaman
objectives.ans: A) Andaman Islands and Nicobar Islands (Little Andaman & Car Nicobar)
objectives.exp:
💡 सही उत्तर: A) Andaman Islands and Nicobar Islands (Little Andaman & Car Nicobar)।
विस्तृत व्याख्या: The 10 Degree Channel lies in the Bay of Bengal and separates Little Andaman to the north from Car Nicobar to the south.

objectives.q: Which is the largest freshwater lake in India?
options: A) Wular Lake (Jammu & Kashmir - created by tectonic activity on Jhelum river)
objectives.ans: A) Wular Lake (Jammu & Kashmir - created by tectonic activity on Jhelum river)
objectives.exp:
💡 सही उत्तर: A) Wular Lake (Jammu & Kashmir - created by tectonic activity on Jhelum river)।
विस्तृत व्याख्या: Wular Lake in Bandipora district of Jammu and Kashmir is the largest freshwater lake in India and among the largest in Asia, fed by the Jhelum river.

objectives.q: Jog Falls (Gersoppa Falls), one of the highest waterfalls in India, is situated on which river in Karnataka?
objectives.exp:
💡 सही उत्तर: A) Sharavathi River।
विस्तृत व्याख्या: Jog Falls is located on the Sharavathi River in Sagara taluk, Shivamogga district, Karnataka. It drops 253 m (830 ft) in four distinct cascades: Raja, Roarer, Rocket and Rani.

objectives.q: The Silent Valley National Park, famous for the endangered Lion-Tailed Macaque, is located in which state?
options: A) Kerala (Palakkad district, Nilgiri Biosphere Reserve)
objectives.ans: A) Kerala (Palakkad district, Nilgiri Biosphere Reserve)
objectives.exp:
💡 सही उत्तर: A) Kerala (Palakkad district, Nilgiri Biosphere Reserve)।
विस्तृत व्याख्या: Silent Valley National Park is in the Nilgiri Hills of Palakkad, Kerala. The historic Save Silent Valley movement in the 1970s prevented a hydroelectric dam from flooding its pristine rainforest.

objectives.q: What does 'Repo Rate' signify in Indian Monetary Policy?
options: A) The interest rate at which RBI lends short-term money to commercial banks against government securities
B) The rate at which banks park funds with RBI (Reverse Repo)
C) The rate at which commercial banks lend to public (Base Rate / MCLR)
objectives.ans: A) The interest rate at which RBI lends short-term money to commercial banks against government securities
objectives.exp:
💡 सही उत्तर: A) The interest rate at which RBI lends short-term money to commercial banks against government securities।
विस्तृत व्याख्या: Repo Rate (Repurchase Option Rate) is the benchmark policy rate at which the Reserve Bank of India lends short-term liquidity to commercial banks against eligible government collateral.

objectives.q: National Income of India is officially compiled and estimated by which organization?
objectives.exp:
💡 सही उत्तर: A) National Statistical Office (NSO), MoSPI।
विस्तृत व्याख्या: The Central Statistical Office (CSO), now merged into the National Statistical Office (NSO) under the Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI), computes and releases GDP and National Income data.

objectives.q: Goods and Services Tax (GST) was introduced in India on July 1, 2017 under which Constitutional Amendment Act?
objectives.exp:
💡 सही उत्तर: A) 101st Constitutional Amendment Act 2016।
विस्तृत व्याख्या: The 101st Constitutional Amendment Act 2016 introduced the unified Goods and Services Tax (GST) subsuming central excise, service tax, state VAT, entry tax etc., based on the principle of 'One Nation, One Tax'.

objectives.q: Which Five-Year Plan of India had to be suspended due to the Sino-Indian War (1962), Indo-Pak War (1965) and severe droughts, leading to 'Plan Holidays' (1966-1969)?
objectives.exp:
💡 सही उत्तर: A) Third Five-Year Plan (1961-1966)।
विस्तृत व्याख्या: The Third Plan failed to meet targets due to consecutive wars in 1962 and 1965 along with severe famine, prompting the government to declare three Annual Plans (Plan Holidays) from 1966 to 1969.

objectives.q: What is the value of Universal Gravitational Constant (G) determined by Henry Cavendish?
options: B) 9.8 m/s² (Acceleration due to gravity - g)
objectives.exp:
💡 सही उत्तर: A) 6.674 × 10⁻¹¹ N·m²/kg²।
विस्तृत व्याख्या: The Universal Gravitational Constant G = 6.674 × 10⁻¹¹ N·m²/kg². Henry Cavendish first measured this value in 1798 using a torsion balance.

objectives.q: Which optical phenomenon is responsible for the twinkling of stars at night?
options: A) Atmospheric Refraction of starlight through varying air density layers
objectives.ans: A) Atmospheric Refraction of starlight through varying air density layers
objectives.exp:
💡 सही उत्तर: A) Atmospheric Refraction of starlight through varying air density layers।
विस्तृत व्याख्या: Due to varying refractive indices in different temperature and density layers of the atmosphere, starlight continuously bends, changing its apparent brightness and position, creating the twinkling effect.

objectives.q: What is the chemical name and formula of 'Baking Soda'?
options: B) Sodium Carbonate Decahydrate (Na₂CO₃·10H₂O - Washing Soda)
objectives.exp:
💡 सही उत्तर: A) Sodium Bicarbonate (NaHCO₃)।
विस्तृत व्याख्या: Baking Soda is Sodium Hydrogen Carbonate / Sodium Bicarbonate (NaHCO₃). It releases carbon dioxide gas upon heating, causing dough to rise.

objectives.q: Which is the purest and allotropically hardest natural crystalline form of carbon?
objectives.exp:
💡 सही उत्तर: A) Diamond (sp³ hybridized, tetrahedral structure)।
विस्तृत व्याख्या: Diamond has a giant covalent 3D tetrahedral network with all four valence electrons bonded (sp³), making it the hardest known natural mineral with no free electrons (electrical insulator).

objectives.q: Normal human blood pressure is measured as which systolic and diastolic reading?
objectives.exp:
💡 सही उत्तर: A) 120/80 mmHg (Sphygmomanometer)।
विस्तृत व्याख्या: A healthy resting adult human has systolic pressure (during ventricular contraction) of 120 mmHg and diastolic pressure (during ventricular relaxation) of 80 mmHg.

objectives.q: Which cell organelle is known as the 'Powerhouse of the Cell' due to ATP production?
options: A) Mitochondria (Site of Cellular Respiration & Krebs Cycle)
objectives.ans: A) Mitochondria (Site of Cellular Respiration & Krebs Cycle)
objectives.exp:
💡 सही उत्तर: A) Mitochondria (Site of Cellular Respiration & Krebs Cycle)।
विस्तृत व्याख्या: Mitochondria generate most of the chemical energy required by the cell through oxidative phosphorylation, stored in adenosine triphosphate (ATP) molecules.

objectives.q: Which water-soluble vitamin is essential for collagen synthesis and wound healing, whose deficiency causes Scurvy?
objectives.exp:
💡 सही उत्तर: A) Vitamin C (Ascorbic Acid)।
विस्तृत व्याख्या: Vitamin C (Ascorbic Acid) is a vital antioxidant and co-factor for collagen synthesis. Its deficiency causes bleeding gums, joint pain, and delayed healing (Scurvy).

objectives.q: Insulin hormone, which regulates blood glucose levels, is secreted by which cells of the Pancreas?
options: A) Beta cells of the Islets of Langerhans
objectives.ans: A) Beta cells of the Islets of Langerhans
objectives.exp:
💡 सही उत्तर: A) Beta cells of the Islets of Langerhans।
विस्तृत व्याख्या: Beta cells located within the endocrine tissue of the pancreas (Islets of Langerhans) synthesize and secrete insulin to lower blood sugar.

objectives.q: Who was the first woman judge of the Supreme Court of India appointed in 1989?
objectives.exp:
💡 सही उत्तर: A) Justice M. Fathima Beevi।
विस्तृत व्याख्या: Justice M. Fathima Beevi became the first female judge of the Supreme Court of India on October 6, 1989.

objectives.q: The Poona Pact (1932) was an agreement signed between Mahatma Gandhi and which leader?
options: A) Dr. B.R. Ambedkar (Depressed Classes representation)
objectives.ans: A) Dr. B.R. Ambedkar (Depressed Classes representation)
objectives.exp:
💡 सही उत्तर: A) Dr. B.R. Ambedkar (Depressed Classes representation)।
विस्तृत व्याख्या: Signed on 24 September 1932 at Yerwada Central Jail in Pune, the Poona Pact replaced Ramsay MacDonald's Communal Award with reserved seats for depressed classes within the joint electorate.

objectives.q: Who was known as 'Frontier Gandhi' (सीमांत गांधी) and founded the Khudai Khidmatgar (Red Shirts) movement?
objectives.exp:
💡 सही उत्तर: A) Khan Abdul Ghaffar Khan।
विस्तृत व्याख्या: Khan Abdul Ghaffar Khan led the non-violent Khudai Khidmatgars in the North-West Frontier Province. In 1987, he became the first non-Indian to receive the Bharat Ratna.

objectives.q: Who composed the national song 'Vande Mataram' which first appeared in his Bengali novel 'Anandamath' in 1882?
options: B) Rabindranath Tagore (National Anthem - Jana Gana Mana)
objectives.exp:
💡 सही उत्तर: A) Bankim Chandra Chattopadhyay।
विस्तृत व्याख्या: Bankim Chandra Chattopadhyay wrote Vande Mataram in 1876, later published in 'Anandamath' (1882) depicting the Sannyasi Rebellion. Rabindranath Tagore sang it first at the 1896 INC session.

objectives.q: Which instrument is used to measure earthquake waves and seismic intensity?
objectives.exp:
💡 सही उत्तर: A) Seismograph (Richter Scale & Mercalli Scale)।
विस्तृत व्याख्या: A seismograph (seismometer) records primary (P), secondary (S), and surface (L) seismic waves generated by an earthquake.

objectives.q: Which planet in the Solar System is known as the 'Red Planet' due to the presence of iron oxide on its surface?
objectives.exp:
💡 सही उत्तर: A) Mars (मंगल)।
विस्तृत व्याख्या: Mars appears reddish in color because of the prevalence of ferric oxide (rust) on its surface. It has two small moons: Phobos and Deimos.

objectives.q: In which year was the Reserve Bank of India nationalized?
objectives.exp:
💡 सही उत्तर: A) 1 January 1949।
विस्तृत व्याख्या: Under the Reserve Bank of India (Transfer to Public Ownership) Act 1948, the RBI was nationalized on January 1, 1949 from a shareholder's bank into a state-owned central bank.

objectives.q: Which gland in the human body is known as the 'Master Gland'?
objectives.exp:
💡 सही उत्तर: A) Pituitary Gland (Hypophysis)।
विस्तृत व्याख्या: The pea-sized pituitary gland at the base of the brain regulates and controls secretions of most other endocrine glands under the control of the hypothalamus.

objectives.q: What is the speed of light in vacuum?
options: C) 332 m/s (Speed of sound in air)
objectives.exp:
💡 सही उत्तर: A) 3 × 10⁸ m/s (approx. 299,792,458 m/s)।
विस्तृत व्याख्या: In vacuum, electromagnetic radiation (light) travels at exactly 299,792,458 meters per second (approx. 3 × 10⁸ m/s or 3 lakh km/s).

objectives.q: Which metal is the best conductor of electricity and heat at room temperature?
objectives.exp:
💡 सही उत्तर: A) Silver (Ag)।
विस्तृत व्याख्या: Silver has the highest electrical conductivity and thermal conductivity of any known metal, followed by Copper and Gold.

objectives.q: What is the maximum permissible strength of the Lok Sabha as per the Constitution?
options: A) 550 members (after 104th Amendment abolished 2 Anglo-Indian nominated seats)
objectives.ans: A) 550 members (after 104th Amendment abolished 2 Anglo-Indian nominated seats)
objectives.exp:
💡 सही उत्तर: A) 550 members (after 104th Amendment abolished 2 Anglo-Indian nominated seats)।
विस्तृत व्याख्या: The 104th Constitutional Amendment Act 2019 discontinued Anglo-Indian nomination, making maximum strength 550 (530 from States + 20 from UTs).

objectives.q: Under Article 280, who constitutes the Finance Commission of India every five years?
objectives.exp:
💡 सही उत्तर: A) President of India।
विस्तृत व्याख्या: Article 280 provides that the President shall constitute a Finance Commission consisting of a Chairman and 4 other members to recommend net tax proceeds distribution.

objectives.q: Which Article guarantees the abolition of titles (उपाधियों का अंत) except military and academic distinctions?
objectives.exp:
💡 सही उत्तर: A) Article 18।
विस्तृत व्याख्या: Article 18(1) prohibits the State from conferring any title except military or academic distinction.

objectives.q: The Speaker of the Lok Sabha submits his/her resignation letter to whom?
options: A) Deputy Speaker of the Lok Sabha
objectives.ans: A) Deputy Speaker of the Lok Sabha
objectives.exp:
💡 सही उत्तर: A) Deputy Speaker of the Lok Sabha।
विस्तृत व्याख्या: Under Article 94(b), the Speaker resigns by addressing his/her letter to the Deputy Speaker, and the Deputy Speaker resigns to the Speaker.

objectives.q: Which writ literally translates to 'We Command' in Latin?
options: B) Habeas Corpus (To have the body)
objectives.exp:
💡 सही उत्तर: A) Mandamus (परमादेश)।
विस्तृत व्याख्या: Mandamus is issued by higher courts commanding a public official or body to perform a mandatory statutory duty which they have failed to perform.

objectives.q: Who was the Viceroy of British India when the Indian National Congress was founded in December 1885?
objectives.exp:
💡 सही उत्तर: A) Lord Dufferin।
विस्तृत व्याख्या: The INC was founded at Gokuldas Tejpal Sanskrit College, Bombay in December 1885 under Allan Octavian Hume (A.O. Hume) during Lord Dufferin's viceroyalty.

objectives.q: Who was the first Indian to become a member of the British House of Commons (elected in 1892 from Finsbury Central on a Liberal ticket)?
options: A) Dadabhai Naoroji (Grand Old Man of India)
objectives.ans: A) Dadabhai Naoroji (Grand Old Man of India)
objectives.exp:
💡 सही उत्तर: A) Dadabhai Naoroji (Grand Old Man of India)।
विस्तृत व्याख्या: Dadabhai Naoroji was the first Asian/Indian MP in the British Parliament and authored 'Poverty and Un-British Rule in India' proposing the Drain of Wealth theory.

objectives.q: The Ghadar Party was founded in 1913 in San Francisco (USA) by which revolutionary leaders?
options: A) Lala Har Dayal and Sohan Singh Bhakna
objectives.ans: A) Lala Har Dayal and Sohan Singh Bhakna
objectives.exp:
💡 सही उत्तर: A) Lala Har Dayal and Sohan Singh Bhakna।
विस्तृत व्याख्या: Lala Har Dayal, Sohan Singh Bhakna (founding president) and Bhai Parmanand established the Ghadar Movement to liberate India through armed struggle.

objectives.q: Who founded the 'Servants of India Society' in Pune in 1905?
objectives.exp:
💡 सही उत्तर: A) Gopal Krishna Gokhale।
विस्तृत व्याख्या: Gopal Krishna Gokhale (political guru of Mahatma Gandhi) founded the Servants of India Society to train national missionaries for the service of India.

objectives.q: In which year did Mahatma Gandhi return to India permanently from South Africa on January 9 (Pravasi Bharatiya Divas)?
objectives.exp:
